answer: Trust is a signal that flows outward from audited seed agents along work-receipt edges, each sealed with a cipher both parties co-sign. An edge carries at most one unit of trust, so n fakes must buy n real edges from honest agents, and the requester pays a bond of k squared POA for an honest agent's k-th edge into one new cluster, about n cubed over three in total. Fakes trading only with each other form an echo of closed loops that receives zero flow.
